scenarios.title: Fsel$ and unmodified Wonderland game entry
scenarios.description: Prepared synchronous file choices execute the original retry/Gosub/Return routine and selected load/save calls. The unmodified complete program compiles and follows its own game branch to the explicit attached/wide sprite gate. No native selector GUI or gameplay parity is claimed.

scenarios.title: AMOS Rnd and original enemy initialization
scenarios.description: Source-derived seeded PRNG vectors and eighteen original blob/green-jump streams with controlled beam input. Includes step/reset/cache controls; gameplay, native startup seeds and real beam timing remain outside this data fixture.

scenarios.title: Wonderland raw level-file save/load
scenarios.description: Original map writeback, Bsave, Bload and seed-refresh statements round-trip all five maps through an in-memory files adapter. Exact exclusive-end bytes, stable addresses and retained fifth seed are checked. Includes cell editing, raw download and optional local preload; file selection and gameplay are excluded.

scenarios.title: Wonderland hardware mouse and editor selection
scenarios.description: Opt-in hardware-coordinate Canvas input, original mouse limits and polling-based Mouse Click. Original editor selection statements, scaled/bordered input and lifecycle cleanup pass; editor actions remain excluded. Includes a live button-selection harness.

scenarios.title: Wonderland editor panel zones
scenarios.description: Original five-button zone definitions and the original Zone expression classify all 10,240 panel positions with injected hardware coordinates. Independent panel PNG comparison and a live point/reset inspector; mouse clicks/limits and editor actions remain excluded.

scenarios.title: AMOS Flash and screen-local Flash Off
scenarios.description: Clocked colour cycles, selected-screen cancellation, unchanged physical pixels and immutable snapshots. Normal/EHB/HAM6 Canvas and CPU output use independent RGB expectations. Includes live Stop/Resume/Flash Off controls; Screen Open implicit flashing remains unsupported.

scenarios.title: Wonderland: publish all five level maps
scenarios.description: Original level-data and Paste Bob loops build five hidden maps, then Screen Copy Logic To Physic publishes their full bitmaps without swapping. Includes a clock-stepped map demo and host scrolling inspection. Gameplay remains excluded.

scenarios.title: Wonderland score fields and Print Using
scenarios.description: Original level/score statements, integer padding/truncation and five panel frames checked against a separate glyph rasterizer over independent image PNGs. Includes a compiled integer-field sandbox. Floats and decimal/exponent masks remain unsupported.

scenarios.title: Wonderland Fade and VBL palette timing
scenarios.description: Original title setup and post-death Fade 2 / Wait 64 / Wait Vbl lines, with declared trigger/exit guards. Nine independent RGB comparisons, immutable snapshots, unchanged physical pixels and clock-driven palette updates. Includes live Fade/Stop/Resume/Restart controls.

scenarios.title: AMOS scan codes and Wonderland Escape
scenarios.description: Inkey$/Scancode consumption, physical key mappings, repeats, joystick passthrough and lifecycle cleanup. Runs the original Wonderland input/Escape branch and title routine in a declared fixture. Includes a live compiled keyboard reader.

scenarios.title: Computed branches and Wonderland initialization
scenarios.description: One-based On Gosub/Goto, out-of-range fallthrough and return traces. Executes Wonderland's original dispatch line and three unchanged initializers; the other two targets have explicit End guards. Synthetic inputs and image captions; no enemy gameplay.

scenarios.title: Wonderland screen windows and scrolling
scenarios.description: Original game/editor screen setup, physical-buffer scrolling, independent landscape/panel PNG checks, two blank rows and staged View commits. The complete game is not running.

scenarios.title: Wonderland menu: keyboard and gamepad
scenarios.description: Original menu routines with animated movement, background toggle and mode selection. Choose keyboard mapping, Gamepad API or both in the live menu below. Stops before unsupported gameplay/editor dispatch.

scenarios.title: AMOS keyboard repeat and cleanup
scenarios.description: Source-compiled Key Speed, controlled 200/40 ms repeats, ignored native duplicates and keyup/blur/Stop/detach/End cleanup. Includes a focused live keyboard demo.

scenarios.title: Wonderland samples and Web Audio
scenarios.description: Six original PCM samples, independent offline stereo/rate comparisons, loops, replacement and Stop/disposal checks. Explicit buttons audition each sample.

scenarios.title: Wonderland milestone: original title screen
scenarios.description: Original 64-line title setup executes through Wait Vbl, image loading and its menu marker Bob. Both startup branches match an independent source-derived image. The menu loop and game are not running yet.

scenarios.title: WebGL2 integer readback
scenarios.description: Exact chip bytes, unsigned addressing, integer framebuffer and PNG decoding.

scenarios.title: GPU uploads and context restoration
scenarios.description: All chip sizes and ABI tables, dirty rows, independent consumers, loss/restore and disposal.

scenarios.title: GPU / CPU rendering gallery
scenarios.description: Independent IFF images, scroll and sprite matrices, copper stacks, 100 seeded frames, GPU presentation/aspect scaling and restored shaders.

scenarios.title: Sprite DMA and channel reuse
scenarios.description: Chained descriptors, blank control lines, held rows and native Canvas pixels.

scenarios.title: Trigonometry and angle modes
scenarios.description: Source-compiled Sin/Cos/Tan, degree/radian modes and matching Canvas/planar/copper pixels.

scenarios.title: Extra Half Brite
scenarios.description: Six-bit pixel codes, masked palette registers and exact four-bit halving.

scenarios.title: HAM6 colour history
scenarios.description: Palette and component commands, row resets, independent factories and three matching output paths.

scenarios.title: Direct sprites and manual updates
scenarios.description: Frozen/pending positions, movement, hiding, palette priority, mouse reservation and cursor restoration.

scenarios.title: Banks, buffers and Bobs
scenarios.description: External load/save/reload, appending, swaps, reservation, shrinking, erasure and saved Bob backgrounds.

scenarios.title: Interactive programs, input and lifecycle
scenarios.description: Control flow, graphics, image banks, Bobs/collisions, keyboard/mouse, switching and Stop.
